body: 94 PNGs at previews/fighters/ (commit a10805c). Start with contact_front.png, contact_posed.png, contact_faces.png, contact_hands.png, then the per-fighter full-res files fNN_*_{front,3q,side,back,posed,face,hand}.png. girth_range_f01.png and girth_range_f01_trunk.png are the apply_girth decision images; girth_heavy_f02*.png ask whether an already-heavy mesh doubles up. lineup.png is the roster at its own statures. Pushed before my verdict on purpose - judge them cold, my R76_FIGHTER_REVIEW.md does not exist yet.
